statement: Born from a desire to cook close to the water, HAVN is an interplay of salt, smoke and season. Our background in coastal kitchens led us to a room of sixteen seats and a single hearth. We buy whole fish from day boats, bake our own rye each morning, and let the catch decide the menu. We believe a meal can not only feed the people we gather, but in part, plays a role in reflecting the place it came from.
